title: Bima Calls to Apologize for Interrupting in the Meeting
script: Bima: [nervous] Laras, do you have a minute? I wanted to call you about the meeting this afternoon.
Laras: Of course, Bima. What's on your mind?
Bima: [regretfully] I interrupted you twice while you were presenting the budget report, and I have felt bad about it since then.
Laras: [directly] I noticed that too, actually. What happened?
Bima: I was excited about my idea, so I spoke before you finished your sentence, both times. I did not mean to be disrespectful.
Laras: [gently] I understand that excitement can make us forget our manners sometimes, but it did make me lose my train of thought.
Bima: I know interrupting someone who is speaking shows a lack of respect, even when the intention behind it is good.
Laras: [warmly] I appreciate that you noticed and called me about it afterward. That says a lot about you as a colleague.
Bima: [worried] I keep thinking about how it must have looked to the rest of the team, as if I did not value your presentation.
Laras: Honestly, nobody else seemed to notice as much as you think they did. But I am glad you are aware of it.
Bima: [determined] Next time I have an idea during a meeting, I will write it down and wait until you finish speaking completely.
Laras: That's a smart habit. You can also just raise your hand quietly if the idea feels urgent to share.
Bima: Thank you for not being upset with me. I really respect you as a colleague and as a friend.
Laras: [honestly] I was frustrated during the presentation, but your apology and clear plan help repair the situation.
Bima: Still, I wanted to apologize properly, instead of just saying a quick sorry tomorrow morning before the next meeting.
Laras: [appreciatively] I appreciate that more than you know, Bima. Thank you for calling and being honest with me.
Bima: Of course. See you at tomorrow's meeting, and I will use my notes and wait for the discussion time this time.
Laras: [smiling] I look forward to it. Have a good evening, Bima, and thank you again for this call.

quiz.question: Why is Bima calling Laras?
options: To apologize for interrupting her during a meeting
To ask for a raise
To cancel tomorrow's meeting
To share a new project idea
quiz.explanation: Bima calls to apologize for interrupting Laras twice while she was presenting the budget report.

quiz.question: Why did Bima interrupt Laras during the presentation?
options: He wanted to end the meeting early
He was excited about his idea and spoke before she finished
He misheard what she said
He was asked to by another coworker
quiz.explanation: Bima explains he was excited about his idea, so he spoke before she finished her sentence.

quiz.question: How does Laras respond to Bima's apology?
options: She appreciates that he noticed and called her about it
She says she is very upset with him
She refuses to speak with him
She ends the meeting for tomorrow
quiz.explanation: Laras tells Bima she appreciates that he noticed and called her, saying it says a lot about him.

quiz.question: What does Bima plan to do next time he has an idea in a meeting?
options: Interrupt again if it feels important
Send her a message instead of attending
Write it down and wait until Laras finishes speaking
Ask someone else to speak for him
quiz.explanation: Bima decides to write his idea down and wait until Laras finishes speaking completely.

quiz.question: What does Laras suggest as an alternative if an idea feels urgent?
options: Shout to get attention
Leave the meeting
Text her during the meeting
Raise a hand quietly
quiz.explanation: Laras suggests Bima could raise his hand quietly if the idea feels urgent to share.

quiz.question: What effect did the interruptions have on Laras?
options: They made her lose her train of thought
They improved the report
They shortened the whole meeting
They made the budget clearer
quiz.explanation: Laras names the practical effect instead of only discussing intention.

quiz.question: Why is Bima worried about the rest of the team?
options: They did not receive the report
They heard his private call
They disliked his idea
His behavior may have looked disrespectful
quiz.explanation: He realizes interruptions can communicate a message he did not intend.

quiz.question: What does “lose my train of thought” mean?
options: Forget the idea being explained
Miss a train after work
Change the meeting room
Reject a colleague’s opinion
quiz.explanation: The interruptions broke Laras’s concentration while speaking.

quiz.question: Why is Laras’s revised response more useful than “I am not upset”?
options: It says the interruption did not happen
It removes Bima from future meetings
It honestly names the impact and accepts the repair
It avoids discussing any next step
quiz.explanation: A good repair can include both honest impact and a constructive plan.

quiz.question: Which action will show that Bima’s apology is sincere?
options: Calling Laras every evening
Waiting for discussion time in the next meeting
Explaining his intention to the whole team
Avoiding all future ideas
quiz.explanation: Changed behavior completes the verbal apology.
